set -euo pipefail; cd projects/kobra2-neo; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

src=Path('src/kobra_live.py')
s=src.read_text()
s=s.replace('stock Marlin thermal monitor is healthy, performs the explicitly approved\nhoming preamble', 'profile-declared hardware preflight is satisfied, performs the explicitly approved\nhoming preamble')
old='''        workspace = value["workspace"]\n        tool = value["tool"]\n        return {\n            "min_x": float(workspace["min_x"]) + float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "max_x": float(workspace["max_x"]) - float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "min_y": float(workspace["min_y"]) + float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "max_y": float(workspace["max_y"]) - float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "pen_up_z": float(tool["pen_up_z"]),\n            "pen_down_z": float(tool["pen_down_z"]),\n        }'''
new='''        workspace = value["workspace"]\n        tool = value["tool"]\n        hardware = value.get("hardware", {})\n        thermal_monitor_required = hardware.get("thermal_monitor_required", True)\n        if not isinstance(thermal_monitor_required, bool):\n            raise TypeError("hardware.thermal_monitor_required must be boolean")\n        return {\n            "min_x": float(workspace["min_x"]) + float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "max_x": float(workspace["max_x"]) - float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "min_y": float(workspace["min_y"]) + float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "max_y": float(workspace["max_y"]) - float(workspace["margin"]),\n            "pen_up_z": float(tool["pen_up_z"]),\n            "pen_down_z": float(tool["pen_down_z"]),\n            "thermal_monitor_required": thermal_monitor_required,\n        }'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('profile load block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''        hotend_c = _check_thermal_monitor(serial)\n        _progress("thermal", "THERMAL_MONITOR_OK", current=0, total=len(commands), metrics={"hotend_c": hotend_c})'''
new='''        thermal_monitor_required = job["profile"]["thermal_monitor_required"]\n        if thermal_monitor_required:\n            hotend_c = _check_thermal_monitor(serial)\n            _progress("thermal", "THERMAL_MONITOR_OK", current=0, total=len(commands), metrics={"hotend_c": hotend_c})\n        else:\n            _progress("thermal", "THERMAL_MONITOR_NOT_REQUIRED", current=0, total=len(commands), metrics={"headless_pen_plotter": True})'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('initial thermal block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''                if index % thermal_check_every == 0 and index < len(commands):\n                    hotend_c = _check_thermal_monitor(serial)\n                    _progress("thermal", f"THERMAL_MONITOR_OK {index}/{len(commands)}", current=index, total=len(commands), metrics={"hotend_c": hotend_c})'''
new='''                if thermal_monitor_required and index % thermal_check_every == 0 and index < len(commands):\n                    hotend_c = _check_thermal_monitor(serial)\n                    _progress("thermal", f"THERMAL_MONITOR_OK {index}/{len(commands)}", current=index, total=len(commands), metrics={"hotend_c": hotend_c})'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('periodic thermal block not found')
s=s.replace(old,new)
src.write_text(s)

profile=Path('config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml')
p=profile.read_text()
if '[hardware]' not in p:
    p=p.replace('\n[tool]\n', '\n[hardware]\nhotend_present = false\nthermal_monitor_required = false\n\n[tool]\n')
profile.write_text(p)

test=Path('tests/test_kobra_live.py')
t=test.read_text()
t=t.replace('    extract_hotend_temperature,\n    main,', '    extract_hotend_temperature,\n    _load_profile,\n    main,')
marker='''def test_extract_hotend_temperature_from_m105() -> None:\n'''
insert='''def test_pen_plotter_profile_declares_thermal_monitor_not_required() -> None:\n    assert _load_profile(PROFILE)["thermal_monitor_required"] is False\n\n\n'''
if insert not in t:
    if marker not in t: raise SystemExit('test insertion marker missing')
    t=t.replace(marker,insert+marker)
test.write_text(t)

hw=Path('docs/HARDWARE.md')
h=hw.read_text()
anchor='## Thermal-monitor dependency discovered 2026-09-28'
if anchor in h:
    start=h.index(anchor)
    end=h.find('\n## Controller identity', start)
    if end < 0: raise SystemExit('hardware doc controller section missing')
    replacement='''## Headless pen-plotter thermal contract — 2026-09-29\n\nThe current physical machine intentionally has no print hotend, no heater cartridge and no hotend thermistor; the tool is a pen holder. Therefore `M105` reporting `T:0.00` is expected and is not a precondition failure for pen plotting. The canonical pen profile declares `hotend_present = false` and `thermal_monitor_required = false`, so `kobra-live` does not issue proactive `M105` checks in this configuration.\n\nThis does **not** suppress or ignore firmware faults. Every streamed command is still acknowledgement-driven, and any spontaneous `MINTEMP`, `MAXTEMP`, `Printer halted` or `kill() called` response remains terminal. Heater commands remain forbidden in artwork. The operator must not enable nozzle heating from the printer UI in this headless configuration.\n'''
    h=h[:start]+replacement+h[end:]
hw.write_text(h)

gold=Path('docs/GOLDEN_LIVE_FLOW.md')
g=gold.read_text()
g=g.replace('verifies the stock thermal monitor with `M105`, homes XY then Z, raises the pen,', 'applies the profile-declared hardware preflight (the current headless pen profile intentionally requires no hotend thermistor), homes XY then Z, raises the pen,')
g=g.replace('5. **Thermal monitor health.** Even with heaters disabled, stock Marlin still enforces E0 thermal safety. `M105` must return a plausible cold hotend value before motion. The runner repeats this check periodically during long plots.', '5. **Hardware profile.** The current headless pen profile declares no hotend/heater/thermistor and therefore does not require `M105`. Profiles that declare `thermal_monitor_required=true` retain the temperature gate. Firmware-reported `MINTEMP`, `MAXTEMP`, halt or kill responses are always terminal.')
g=g.replace('THERMAL_MONITOR_OK', 'THERMAL_MONITOR_NOT_REQUIRED  # current headless pen profile (or THERMAL_MONITOR_OK for monitored profiles)')
gold.write_text(g)
PY
